data.title: 鲸鲨掠过头顶的蓝海隧道
data.location: 深蓝弧形海底水族馆隧道
data.prompt: 1girl, solo, ayachi_nene, pale yellow linen sundress, white crochet bolero, white ankle socks, cream flat shoes, one hand against curved glass, turning back, laughing, sparkling eyes, underwater aquarium tunnel, giant whale shark overhead, schools of silver fish, glowing blue water, caustic light patterns on dress and floor, wide angle, from below, full body
data.animaCaption: With one palm pressed lightly against the curved acrylic wall as a massive whale shark glides overhead, she spins back toward you laughing in pure wonder. Shimmering aqua water caustics ripple across her pale yellow sundress and the dark walkway.
data.promptProse: Captured in a sweeping low-angle wide shot inside a curved underwater aquarium tunnel, Ayachi Nene wears a breezy pale-yellow linen sundress paired with a lacy white crochet bolero and cream flats. Resting one hand on the glowing acrylic tunnel wall while a colossal whale shark and shimmering fish swim silently overhead, she pivots back toward the viewer with an open-hearted laugh. Rippling cyan water caustics dance across her skirt, hair, and the wet-looking polished floor, immersing the entire frame in luminous deep-ocean blues.
data.story: 巨大的鲸鲨拖着银色鱼群从玻璃穹顶缓缓游过，流动的水纹把整条隧道染成会呼吸的深蓝。宁宁一手轻贴在微凉的玻璃壁上，回过身朝你露出藏不住的孩子气笑容——「快看头顶！感觉我们像真的沉进海底一样！」
